content:
Apple today released a fun ad promoting the all-new Mac mini with the M6 chip. Apple subsequently also shared a behind-the-scenes making-of video, showcasing some of the (significant) effort that went into producing this ad. The clip is short, watch it now.

"We had to sculpt and create everything by hand"

Apple's @helloapple Instagram account today posted a brief Instagram Reels showing some of the production process behind their fun ad for the all-new Mac mini equipped with the M6 chip.

In the clip (via MacMagazine), animators Justin Rasch and Scott DaRos, along with art director Josh Mahan, show the sketches, props, sculptures, techniques and materials used in the making, as well as time-lapse footage and behind-the-scenes glimpses of the stop-motion animation, revealing how various animated elements in the ad were completed step by step.

While this ad may not be quite as wild as the MacBook Neo promotional campaign on TikTok (which has been the case ever since Apple launched this entry-level laptop), it's still quite fun, especially after watching the behind-the-scenes footage and learning just how much physical craftsmanship was involved.
